inventory_provenance.exclusion_rule: Excluded the 4 audit GETs (GET /rest/audit, /rest/audit/export, /rest/audit/retention, /rest/audit/since), all 15 POST, 7 PUT and 8 DELETE rows, because they are administrative and/or mutating. Remaining: 35 GET + the semantic conversion POST = 36.
inventory_provenance.path_normalization: The 6.6 HTML lists paths as /rest/{resource}. Its own example URIs use /rest/api/{resource}; the real Server base is /rest/api. Every 'path' below is the actual /rest/api/... route.
inventory_provenance.inventory_stability: Count 35 GET + 1 POST reproduces the previously established 36-request inventory exactly; no operation was added or dropped.

library_provenance.integrity: sha256 of extracted confluence/server/__init__.py and confluence_base.py equals the installed copies (df09b7f5... and 8122028d...); VERSION=5.0.5 in both.
library_provenance.entry_classes: ConfluenceServer aliases atlassian.confluence.server.Server (confluence/__init__.py:13, confluence/server/confluence_server.py). Method mapping below uses Server.
library_provenance.url_construction: Server.__init__ sets cloud=False, api_root='rest/api', api_version='latest' when not supplied (server/__init__.py:75-88). Server._server_api_path prefixes rest/api for a first path segment in _api_resources {content, contentbody, group, longtask, search, space, user, ...} and omits the version unless api_version was passed explicitly (server/__init__.py:45-62, 90-104, 115-145).

status_rubric.covered: A public Server method constructs exactly the documented route and performs the documented read (pagination/subset caveats recorded separately).
status_rubric.partial: A public method exists but constructs a different route, exposes only a subset of documented representations/parameters, or cannot reach the documented operation.
status_rubric.gap: No public Server (or inherited ConfluenceBase) method constructs the documented route.
status_rubric.uncertain: Source inspection cannot decide the mapping.

limitations: Source-only mapping: no HTTP request was executed and no credentials were used; runtime behavior of every route is unverified.

The library defaults to api_version='latest' and omits the version segment, which matches Confluence 6.6's /rest/api base. Passing api_version explicitly makes _server_api_path append it (e.g. /rest/api/1/content), which is not a Confluence Server 6.6 route; the mapping assumes default construction.

_get_paged branches on api_version == 1; with the Server default ('latest') it takes the V2/cursor branch but still follows _links.next, so V1 offset pagination works incidentally. This is an untested coupling.
Pagination caveats are stated per operation; 'covered' does not imply an iterator for every paginated collection.
The 6.6 HTML is a cached snapshot; no live documentation or target-server probe was available in this read-only task.
Administrative and mutating rows (4 admin audit GETs, 15 POST, 7 PUT, 8 DELETE) were excluded by rule, not implemented or assessed.
